features.summary: 73 keys, E1–E7, 43 white / 30 black, with the E-to-E black key pattern and measured geometry.
Six ordered sections at the corrected v1.2.0 fractions, the 54/46 deck/keybed split, and one continuous chassis.
146 stable control IDs, per-section landmarks and density, and Program and Synth as the only primary OLEDs.
Pointer, independent multi-touch, glissando, cancel, blur and focused-key Space/Enter press and release.
Every visible control moves or presses, shows its state, and changes presentation state only — the audio graph is untouched and the rendered output stays silent.
Roles, accessible names, min/max/value/valuetext, orientation, keyboard operation, labelled regions and visible focus.
Note on/off on rendered audio, repeated and overlapping notes, per-note release shortening the tail, all-notes-off, and node cleanup back to baseline.
Pointer, multi-touch, mapped computer keyboard with repeat suppression, MIDI note/velocity/CC64/all-notes-off, and denied, unsupported and disconnected MIDI states.
Sustain transitions measured on the rendered tail, concurrent voices, deterministic stealing order, polyphony cap, and velocity moving level and filter in the expected direction.
Truthful ready/idle/unsupported/error status and its display, plus blur, MIDI disconnect and unmount stopping every owned voice and closing the context.
No marketing hero or reference image, rail and keybed attached inside one chassis, instrument at 88–97% of a 1440x900 viewport with no vertical scroll, and full width without clipping at 390x844.

notes: Audio behaviour is asserted on real rendered signals: src/audio/offline.ts is a deterministic offline Web Audio implementation that evaluates oscillators, buffer playback, parameter automation and the biquad filter sample by sample, because jsdom provides no Web Audio.
No test requires a physical MIDI device, network access or audio output.
